message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a stylized human figure at the top, wearing glasses and a red and black robe with a white vertical band. The figure leans over a grey surface, holding a wooden gavel and striking it down. From the point of impact, dark, thick, jagged cracks radiate across the grey expanse, some extending toward the right edge and others curving towards the bottom. The cracks create a pattern reminiscent of a map outline on the right. 

The top section of the image is black with large red lettering partially obscured by the figure. Legible text includes "Modus Pencucian Uang Syahrul Yasin Limpo H.80" and "Rahasia Panjang Umur H.52." The center-left text reads "SKANDAL MAHKAMAH KELUARGA" in bold black capital letters. Smaller text below describes actions involving "Anwar Usman" and "Gibran Rakabuming Raka" regarding "Undang-Undang Pemilu." At the bottom, there is a barcode, a QR code, and publication details: "23-29 OKTOBER 2023," "RP 50.000," and "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO." The overall composition uses a limited palette of red, black, white, and various shades of grey.
